info.title: Update Merchant API
info.description: API to update or add information about a merchant, including PAN details, operating information, and more.

put.description: This API allows you to update or add information about a merchant, including PAN details, operating information, and more.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: A unique identifier for the merchant. This must be the uuid value returned by the Create Merchant API for the corresponding merchant.

merchant[pancard_number].description: The PAN card number of the merchant.

merchant[pancard_name].description: The name associated with the PAN card.

merchant[business_entity].description: The type of business entity (e.g., 'Sole Proprietorship', 'Partnership').

merchant[business_category].description: The primary business category of the merchant (e.g., 'Ecommerce').

merchant[business_sub_category].description: A more specific subcategory related to the business (e.g., 'Flowers and Gifts').

merchant[business_name].description: The registered business name of the merchant.

merchant[monthly_expected_volume].description: The monthly expected transaction volume in monetary terms.

merchant[registration_address][address_l.description: Address line of the business's registered address.

merchant[registration_address][state].description: State of the business's registered address.

merchant[registration_address][city].description: City of the business's registered address.

merchant[registration_address][pincode].description: Pincode of the business's registered address.

merchant[operating_address][city].description: City of the business's operating address.

merchant[operating_address][state].description: State of the business's operating address.

merchant[operating_address][address_line.description: Address line of the business's operating address.

merchant[operating_address][pincode].description: Pincode of the business's operating address.

merchant[gst_number].description: The GST number of the merchant.

merchant[integration_type].description: Specifies the type of integration for the merchant's account.

merchant[signing_authority_details][name.description: Name of the authorized representative or signing authority for the merchant's business.

merchant[signing_authority_details][emai.description: Email of the authorized representative or signing authority.

merchant[signing_authority_details][panc.description: PAN card number of the signing authority.

merchant[signing_authority_details][cin_.description: The Corporate Identification Number (CIN) of the business (if applicable).

merchant[website_details][android_url].description: The URL of the business's Android app (if applicable).

merchant[website_details][ios_url].description: The URL of the business's iOS app (if applicable).
